summary:
SPHEREx Xplorer is a public interactive web platform that turns NASA SPHEREx data more accessible and engaging, giving change for people from different background to understand and explore the sky.

This platform allows the user to visualize the changes of the universe at different coordinate, different wavelength, and different time. SPHEREx Xplorer combines scientific data and visualization tools, to close the gap between scientific researches and the public exploration.

With or without specialized astonomical knowledge, everyone should be able to explore the chaning universe.
details:
SPHEREx Xplorer turns complicated data into visualizations, allowing users to explore different celestial objects and how regions on the sky change over time.

How it works:

The platform organizes and analyse the astronomical data from NASA's Infrared Science Archive (IRSA). Where the user can input sky coordinates to explore specific regions; with features that allows the user to compare the region over different time and wavelengths.

The front end of this platform uses Next.js and React, also with Typescript and Tailwind CSS to create an appealing interface. It also uses Aladin Lite, to map out patches of the universe accoding to the inputted coordinate. Whereas the front end uses Fast API of Python, to connect the web platform with the APIs. It also allows processing cache as it can take lots of time to load the data; with it, it can make the calculation process more efficient, making a more user friendly platform

Creativity:

The platform doesnt now only contain the basic features of visualizing and understanding the universe, it also solves our sub goal aside form the space challenge mission, which is an opportunity for everyone to discover possible habitats that can/may have contain lifes, and compare different regions with earth. Where the platform allows the user to look at different life ingredients, like water ice, and the composition of it in different region. While also compare different characteristics of the region with our earth.

We believe that, as global warming has become a greater and greater issue, people might start to be curious whether there are another planet, another place where life can live. By putting on features that can bring knowledge relating to what the public really cares about, it can make the experience of exploring the universe meaningful and exciting.

Considerations:

In the creating process there are several considerations that we focus on: scientific accuracy and accessibility.

We make it clear that there can be error in the data, displaying all the possible "flags" to warn the user to carefully consider the reliability of the displayed information.

Moreover, to make this platform accessible to people of different backgrounds, we also added some extra features. For example, at the title page where users can input coordinates, we consider that some user might only want to explore and doesnt have any coordinates in mind. That is why we added a random button that can generate random coordinates, bringing the user to random part of the universe.
